0022600135.text: The Pacers, who are 2-2 and sit third in the Central, 1.5 games back and eighth in the East, host the 3-1 Philadelphia 76ers, who are first in the Atlantic and second in the East, in Indiana's fifth game of the season. Indiana is 0-1 at home and coming off a loss, and it is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness), Obi Toppin (hand sprain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring soreness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and the Pacers lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4, including a 105-94 defeat in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
